comments.text:
Thank you for traveling with us across China, from the clouds over the Huajiang Grand Canyon Bridge to the towers of the Pingtang Bridge. 🤍
Which of these first 25 megaprojects impressed you the most, and which one would you most like to see with your own eyes?
👉 Part two is coming, with spiral tunnels through mountains and a 2,000-year-old irrigation system. Subscribe and turn on the bell so you do not miss it.
